text:
caroline: Heads-up — our sampleapp onboarding hit a bundler+edge interoperability bug. Works in Vite dev, but Vite build -> Vercel Edge deploy crashes. Minimal repro and logs below.

mike: Yikes. Paste the runtime error?

caroline: Edge error during lambda/edge init: 
```
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
    at Object.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/var/task/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:12:15)
    at __webpack_require__ (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:25:42)
    at Module.<anonymous> (bootstrap_node.js:559:3)
```

caroline: Meanwhile prerender in local Vite build throws: 
```
Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide an export named 'createClient'
```

sasha: That pattern screams "bundler resolution picked CJS artifact for ESM import". Some bundlers prefer the wrong exports entry.

andre: Which SDK tag? We recently changed exports map and shipped both .mjs and .cjs variants.

caroline: Using @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0-canary.2026.03.20. Downgrading to 2.0.4 avoids the defineProperty crash but then types don't line up.

zoe: What TS failures are you seeing?

caroline: CI tsc fails: 
```
src/inferenceClient.ts:12:7 - error TS2322: Type 'Client' is not assignable to type 'ClientConstructor'.
12 const client = new InferenceClient(opts)
         ~~~~~~
  src/types/index.d.ts:45:5
    45 export interface ClientConstructor {
         ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  Types exported from the package don't match runtime (class vs factory).
```

mike: So multiple simultaneous issues: (1) exports map fallback selecting CJS for ESM consumers, (2) CJS build mutates exports object causing defineProperty in sandboxed Edge, (3) .d.ts shape mismatch.

caroline: I pushed a tiny repro gist: https://gist.github.com/caro/abcd1234 with a minimal Vite app, vite.config, and package.json to reproduce. Steps: 1) git clone gist + npm i; 2) npm run build; 3) npx vercel dev --edge or deploy to Vercel Edge.

sasha: I reproduced on Rollup + SvelteKit too. Rollup's resolver ends up using the package.exports fallback to CJS because of priority ordering.

andre: Short-term mitigations: 
- Vite: add ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] so Vite bundles the ESM sources.
- Rollup/webpack: add an alias to '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js' in bundler config.
- Vercel Edge: import the explicit ESM file: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'`.

zoe: Another practical shim: create a local module `shims/redwood-esm.js` containing `export * from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` and alias the package to that during build. Ugly but works while we fix upstream.

caroline: Filed internal bug infra-inference#2289 with repro and logs: https://redwood.internal/issue/2289. @dev-bot kicked off a CI matrix.

dev-bot: CI run started for infra-inference#2289 — matrix: vite/rollup/webpack, node versions: 18/20.

mike: For the typings, I can do a quick local patch: change types/index.d.ts to `export class InferenceClient { constructor(opts?: any) }` so the shape matches runtime. I'll open a PR for a hotfix.

andre: Long-term fix plan: 
1) Normalize package.json exports so ESM entry is preferred by browsers/bundlers and add explicit `import`/`require` fields.
2) Rebuild CJS without redefining existing export properties (no defineProperty shims).
3) Publish a patch and backport to 2.0.x.
4) Update .d.ts to match runtime and add a TypeScript smoke-test in CI.

sasha: I'll add CI smoke jobs: Vite build + `vercel dev --edge` and a Rollup SvelteKit build. Also add `npm pack` + consumer bundler test so packaging regressions are caught.

caroline: For onboarding, I've added the ssr.noExternal snippet and the alias workaround to the sampleapp templates and onboarding guide.

zoe: Can someone add a short blurb to the SDK release notes and onboarding docs describing the workaround and targeted patch?

mike: I'll draft a release note and a migration snippet for docs. :thumbsup: 

caroline: If folks want the multi-framework minimal repro (SvelteKit/Next/Vite), I can push a mono-repo to the infra-inference org.

andre: Please do and @mention me. I'll triage exports + types.

zoe: Follow-ups: docs update, CI smoke tests, packaging fix.

caroline: Closing for now — will post updates when patch is published.
